title: cyclosorus moluccanus

It is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cyclosorus moluccanus include treating wounds, skin conditions, and digestive issues, as well as acting as an immune system booster. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
